reviews.title: Disconnected and difficult to use
reviews.text: I’m used to using the NYT cooking app and its design is so much easier to use. I love bob Appétit recipes but recipes from bon appetit that come to my inbox via the newsletter never open in the Epicurious app so I can save it, I have to go to the app and search the recipe. And sometimes recipes aren’t even there! The fix is so simple and I would use it so much more if they could make it feel more connected and easy to use and save recipes.

reviews.title: App Stopped Working
reviews.text: Epicurious has been great for a long time and now the app stopped working completely. Signed out and back in, even deleted the app and reinstalled. Still doesn’t work. Their help page says they can only be contacted through the widget on their webpage, but no widget appears. Please fix this issue!

reviews.title: Not free. Bait and switch
reviews.text: Its free to create an account but to see any recipe you must pay. Lol. Terrible business practice

reviews.title: Buggy + awful interface
reviews.text: App never wants to open. Always have to delete and reinstall and most of the time even that won’t work. When it does work, the interface is awful. No ability to search saved recipes so just have to scroll and scroll until you find what you’re looking for. God awful user experience

reviews.title: Subscription required
reviews.text: Just the download is free, everything else needs a subscription. Nothing wrong with that, but say that in the description rather than bait and switch

reviews.title: The app doesn’t seem to want to open anymore
reviews.text: I love this app and have loads of recipes stored in it, but lately it refuses to open. I have tried deleting and reinstalling it but it still won’t.

reviews.title: Love the recipes, not the app
reviews.text: For the life of me, I can’t get this app to load. I’ve deleted and reinstalled the app, restarted my phone and tried every troubleshooting option I could think of and nothing works. The web option works great but the app is like a really really bad soufflé

reviews.title: Recipe Good, function not
reviews.text: This app is good because it has recipes from some of the best cooking magazines. This app is also good because it has really good user reviews of each recipe so you can learn modifications. This app is bad because you can’t store by food type and meal and you can’t sort by most reviewed  just most stars which could be   5 stars with 1 user or 500 users you can’t sort it that way

reviews.title: Paid Subscription, But the App Doesn’t Work at All
reviews.text: Despite having an all-digital access Condé Nast subscription, I’m completely unable to use the app. It gets stuck during startup and never loads any content. I’ve already contacted customer service four times, and the issue still hasn’t been resolved. This has been a really frustrating and disappointing experience.

reviews.title: Used to be Great
reviews.text: This app isn’t as good as it used to be, which is a shame

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text: The fact that you can’t even look at a recipe without paying for a subscription is beyond pathetic. One free week is a total joke imo. Everything is put behind a paywall so they can make money off anyone. If they had, say, 50 free spots of recipes to save, I wouldn’t be so irritated.

reviews.title: lost saved recipes
reviews.text: very disappointed with this app.   Search is cumbersome and doesn’t use search criteria specified - get a lot of unrelated “results.”  Big disappointment that recipes are missing from my saved favorites.  Not sure it is worth the money.

reviews.title: Lacking in function
reviews.text: Great recipes but clearly no investment has been made in the apps functionality. Epicurious should take a good look at the NYT food app.

reviews.title: Slooooooooooooow to open
reviews.text: I think the all I fine overall. But, search and the time it takes to just open are so annoying, I just use the website.

reviews.title: Pointless…
reviews.text: After you download the app, you can’t see any of the actual recipes unless you buy a subscription.  I immediately deleted it.

reviews.title: Hard to cancel, not worth the cost
reviews.text:
Can’t cancel on the app, you need to log in to the website. Clicking through is a little tricky, and for a year there the credentials on the app wouldn’t work on the website.

I also asked them to delete my payment info as I had thought I cancelled my subscription last year. The rep I was chatting with said “no can do” and ended the chat.

Additionally; for the cost of an Epicurious subscription you can instead get both an Apple News and New York Times subscription, both of which offer a lot more along with as many recipes as Epicurious.

100% rip off, I would only recommend this app to people I don’t like.

reviews.title: So annoying
reviews.text:
Every time I switch to another app for 5 minutes and come back to this one, it takes me back to the home screen, so I have to click back to the recipe I was following.
And sometimes it just spins.
